selection.method: 5-fold cross-validation over 4 candidate settings, fitted on the full cohort

preprocessing.note: XGBoost is fitted on raw features in this pipeline; only the linear and Cox learners are standardised. Apply column reordering and NaN->0 fill only.

provenance.training_cohort: TCGA (all samples with this endpoint and representation)

caveat: This model is fitted on the entire TCGA cohort and has NOT been evaluated on held-out TCGA data. All manuscript metrics come from nested out-of-fold predictions of separate fold models. Results from this frozen model on an external cohort are a genuine out-of-sample test, but the model itself is a new artefact and should be described as such in Methods.
